Exchanges are handled as a refund + new purchase.
The creator refunds the original gift, then the recipient buys the item they want instead. This is the standard way exchanges work in Kajabi. 
How the refund works:
From the Kajabi dashboard, click Sales.
Click Payments.
Open the Transactions tab.
Find and open the customer’s transaction.
Click … (More Actions).
Select Refund.
Enter the refund amount and confirm. 
After the refund, the recipient can purchase the new offer they prefer.
